title: Savings Account
text: A Mero Bank savings account requires a minimum balance of NPR 1,000. Interest of 4% per annum is paid quarterly. Customers can open an account at any branch after completing KYC. A cheque book is issued free of charge for the first 25 leaves.

title: Debit Card
text: The Mero Bank debit card has an annual fee of NPR 500. The daily ATM withdrawal limit is NPR 50,000. If the card is lost, call the 24-hour hotline at 01-4123456 to block it immediately. A replacement card is issued within 7 working days.

title: Home Loan
text: Mero Bank home loans carry an interest rate of 9.5% per annum. The bank finances up to 80% of the property value. The maximum loan tenure is 20 years. A processing fee of 1% of the loan amount is charged.

title: Remittance
text: Mero Bank receives remittances through its partner agents. Remittance funds are credited to the account within 24 hours. There is no charge for receiving remittance into a Mero Bank account.

title: Mobile Banking
text: Customers can reset the mobile banking password using the Forgot Password option in the app. A one-time password is sent to the registered mobile number. Mero Bank never asks for your OTP, PIN or password by phone, SMS or email.

title: Fixed Deposit
text: The minimum fixed deposit amount is NPR 10,000. A 6-month fixed deposit earns 7% per annum and a 12-month fixed deposit earns 8% per annum. Premature withdrawal reduces the interest rate by 1 percentage point.

title: KYC Requirements
text: To open an account, customers must submit a completed KYC form. A citizenship certificate or national ID and two passport-size photos are required. Businesses must also provide a PAN registration certificate. Account opening usually takes one working day.

title: Branch Hours and Contact
text: Mero Bank branches are open Sunday to Friday from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Branches are closed on Saturdays and public holidays. Customers can email support@merobank.com.np or call 01-4123456.
